title: Aluminium and stainless (spars and fittings)

stainless.what: 316 castings and tube: stanchions, pulpits, chainplates, shackles, cleat bases, turnbuckles

aluminium.what: clear-anodised extrusions: J/22 mast and boom, Sunfish spars, tiller extension

wear_split: Shared timeK/dirtK (PR #535): timeK dulls polished stainless and fades anodising; dirtK brings the film, tea stain, grime and oxide powder

lake: Fresh water: tea staining and oxide bloom at about a third of the salt-water amount (salt flag doubles them later for Galveston)
